description: React component for managing team details in Mattermost admin console, including team archiving, group and user management, and settings.

classes.name: TeamDetails
classes.description: React component class for team details management in admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches team and group data on mount.

methods.name: setNewGroupRole
methods.description: Toggles admin role for a group.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving or archiving team, including API calls and error handling.

methods.name: setToggles
methods.description: Updates toggle settings and processes group changes.

methods.name: processGroupsChange
methods.description: Processes changes in group selection, updates user removal count.

methods.name: addUsersToAdd
methods.description: Adds users to the list of users to be added to the team.

methods.name: addUserToRemove
methods.description: Marks a user for removal from the team.

methods.name: addRolesToUpdate
methods.description: Updates role (admin/user) status for a user.

methods.name: handleGroupRemoved
methods.description: Removes a group from the selection.

methods.name: hideRemoveUsersModal
methods.description: Hides the user removal confirmation modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Triggers save or archive process based on current state.

methods.name: teamToBeArchived
methods.description: Checks if team is to be archived.

methods.name: teamToBeRestored
methods.description: Checks if team is to be restored from archive.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the team details UI including header, profile, group/user management, and modals.
